question: Which GST thin film in the Sn-incorporated GST terahertz study had the highest conductivity at 1 THz, and what power was its Sn target sputtered at?
expect: Sn24W-GST-250 (σ 17928.63); Sn target at 24 W (Table 1, sec. 2)
rendered: According to Table 1, the GST thin film with the highest conductivity at 1 THz was Sn24W-GST-250, with a conductivity of 17928.63 S/m. This film was prepared with a Sn target sputtering power of 24 W.
